meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成群组的维基维护者：逐个处理来源并生成摘要与关联页面，同时建立目录、索引和规则。
howto.when: 当提到“add wiki”、“wiki”、“knowledge base”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 给这个群组添加一个 LLM 维基。
say.note: 开始执行流程：读取模式并询问群组与设计偏好。

say.text: 把这个网页下载后做成维基来源。
say.note: Claude 会先下载全文，再创建相关页面。

say.text: 每周做一次维基健康检查。
say.note: 会询问是否用 schedule_task 定时执行。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude becomes the group's wiki maintainer: processes each source one at a time, writes summaries and linked pages, and creates directories, indexes, and rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered by keywords such as "add wiki", "wiki", or "knowledge base".

say_en.text: Add an LLM wiki to this group.
say_en.note: Starts the flow, reads pattern, and asks about group and design.

say_en.text: Download this webpage and turn it into a wiki source.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the full text, then creates pages.

say_en.text: Run a weekly wiki health check.
say_en.note: Asks whether to schedule it with schedule_task.
